let active=null, lastTick=Date.now();

function key(id){return "pycourse_week08_"+id}
function state(id){return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key(id))||'{"code":"","time":0,"runs":0,"checks":0,"hints":0,"completed":false,"started":false}')}
function save(id,o){localStorage.setItem(key(id),JSON.stringify(o))}
function fmt(s){s=Math.floor(s);return String(Math.floor(s/60)).padStart(2,"0")+":"+String(s%60).padStart(2,"0")}
function renderSummary(){
 let cells=EX.map(e=>{let s=state(e.id),status=s.completed?"✓ Completed":s.started?"In progress / paused":"Not started";return `<div>${e.title}</div><div>${status}</div><div>${fmt(s.time)}</div><div>${s.runs}</div><div>${s.checks}</div><div>${s.hints}</div>`}).join("");
 let total=EX.reduce((a,e)=>a+state(e.id).time,0), done=EX.filter(e=>state(e.id).completed).length;
 document.getElementById("summary").innerHTML=`<section class="ex"><h2>Week 8 summary</h2><div><strong>Completed:</strong> ${done} / ${EX.length} &nbsp; · &nbsp; <strong>Total active time:</strong> ${fmt(total)}</div><div class="summary-grid"><div class="summary-head">Exercise</div><div class="summary-head">Status</div><div class="summary-head">Active time</div><div class="summary-head">Runs</div><div class="summary-head">Checks</div><div class="summary-head">Hints</div>${cells}</div></section>`;
}

function validNeptun(v){return /^[A-Z0-9]{6}$/.test((v||"").trim().toUpperCase())}
function getNeptun(){return (localStorage.getItem("pycourse_neptun")||"").trim().toUpperCase()}
function setNeptunUI(){
 const box=document.getElementById("neptun-code"),msg=document.getElementById("neptun-message");
 if(!box)return;
 const n=getNeptun(),ok=validNeptun(n); box.value=n;
 msg.textContent=ok?`Neptun code saved: ${n}`:"Enter your 6-character Neptun code before starting the exercises.";
 document.querySelectorAll("[id$='-start']").forEach(b=>b.disabled=COURSE_CONFIG.requireNeptun&&!ok);
}
function saveNeptun(){
 const box=document.getElementById("neptun-code"),msg=document.getElementById("neptun-message");
 const n=(box.value||"").trim().toUpperCase(); box.value=n;
 if(!validNeptun(n)){msg.textContent="Please enter a valid 6-character Neptun code.";return}
 localStorage.setItem("pycourse_neptun",n); setNeptunUI();


}

function render(){
 list.innerHTML=EX.map(e=>{let s=state(e.id);return `<section class="ex" id="${e.id}">
 <div class="head"><div><h2>${e.title}</h2><div>${e.task}</div></div><div class="status" id="${e.id}-status">${s.completed?"✓ Completed":s.started?"Paused":"Not started"} · <span class="timer">${fmt(s.time)}</span></div></div>
 <div class="controls"><button id="${e.id}-start" onclick="startEx('${e.id}')">${s.started?"Continue exercise":"Start exercise"}</button></div>
 <div class="workspace" id="${e.id}-ws">
 <div class="small">Active time: <strong class="timer" id="${e.id}-time">${fmt(s.time)}</strong> · Runs: <span id="${e.id}-runs">${s.runs}</span> · Checks: <span id="${e.id}-checks">${s.checks}</span> · Hints: <span id="${e.id}-hints">${s.hints}</span></div>
 <p><strong>Your Python code</strong></p><textarea class="code" id="${e.id}-code" spellcheck="false">${esc((s.code||e.starter))}</textarea>
 <div class="controls"><button onclick="runEx('${e.id}')">▶ Run</button><button onclick="checkEx('${e.id}')">✓ Check my solution</button><button onclick="hintEx('${e.id}')">💡 Hint</button><button onclick="stopEx('${e.id}')">■ Stop</button></div>
 <strong>Output</strong><pre id="${e.id}-out"></pre><div id="${e.id}-input" class="live-input" hidden></div><div class="checkpanel" id="${e.id}-panel">No check has been run yet.</div></div></section>`}).join("");
 renderSummary();
}
function esc(x){return x.replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;")}
// Student Python always runs in a killable Web Worker, never on the UI thread.
const WEEK08_RUN_TIMEOUT_MS=3000;
const WEEK08_WORKER_URL=new URL('assets/week08-python-worker.js',document.baseURI).href;
let pythonWorker=null,workerJobs=new Map(),workerSeq=0;
function resetPythonWorker(reason="Execution timed out. Check your loop condition and variable updates."){
 if(pythonWorker){pythonWorker.terminate();pythonWorker=null;}
 for(const job of workerJobs.values()){clearTimeout(job.timer);job.reject(new Error(reason));}
 workerJobs.clear();
 for(const e of EX){const area=document.getElementById(e.id+'-input');if(area){area.hidden=true;area.replaceChildren();}}
}
function getPythonWorker(){
 if(pythonWorker)return pythonWorker;
 pythonWorker=new Worker(WEEK08_WORKER_URL);
 pythonWorker.onerror=e=>{resetPythonWorker("Python worker error: "+(e.message||"Unable to load worker. Retry Run."));};
 pythonWorker.onmessage=({data:m})=>{
  const job=workerJobs.get(m.id);if(!job)return;
  const stopTimer=()=>{clearTimeout(job.timer);job.timer=null;};
  const startTimer=()=>{stopTimer();job.timer=setTimeout(()=>resetPythonWorker(),WEEK08_RUN_TIMEOUT_MS);};
  if(m.type==='ready'){job.ready=true;startTimer();return;}
  if(m.type==='output'){if(job.onOutput)job.onOutput(m.chunk);return;}
  if(m.type==='prompt'){
   stopTimer(); // Waiting for a human to type is not Python execution time.
   requestLiveInput(job.exerciseId,m.prompt).then(value=>{
    if(workerJobs.has(m.id)&&pythonWorker){startTimer();pythonWorker.postMessage({type:'input',id:m.id,value});}
   });return;
  }
  if(m.type==='done'||m.type==='error'){
   stopTimer();workerJobs.delete(m.id);
   if(m.type==='done')job.resolve(m.result);else job.reject(new Error(m.error));
  }
 };
 return pythonWorker;
}
function workerTask(type,code,inputs=[],interactive=false,onOutput=null,exerciseId=null){
 return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
  if(workerJobs.size){reject(new Error('Python is busy. Finish the current run or press Stop.'));return;}
  let worker;try{worker=getPythonWorker();}catch(e){reject(e);return;}
  const id=++workerSeq;
  workerJobs.set(id,{resolve,reject,onOutput,exerciseId,timer:setTimeout(()=>resetPythonWorker('Python runtime did not load within 45 seconds.'),45000),ready:false});
  worker.postMessage({type,id,code,inputs,interactive,exerciseId});
 });
}
async function execute(code,inputs,interactive=false,onOutput=null,exerciseId=null){
 return workerTask('execute',code,inputs,interactive,onOutput,exerciseId);
}
async function ensurePy(){getPythonWorker();}
async function startEx(id){
 if(workerJobs.size && active!==id) resetPythonWorker("Run cancelled when switching exercises.");
 if(!document.getElementById("rules-accepted")?.checked){
   alert("Please confirm that you understand and accept the programming rules before starting.");
   return;
 }
 if(COURSE_CONFIG.requireNeptun&&!validNeptun(getNeptun())){
   document.getElementById("neptun-message").textContent="Save a valid Neptun code before starting an exercise.";
   document.getElementById("neptun-code").focus(); return;
 }
 if(active&&active!==id) stopEx(active);
 let s=state(id);
 document.querySelectorAll(".workspace").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("active"));
 document.getElementById(id+"-ws").classList.add("active");
 document.getElementById(id+"-code").value=s.code || EX.find(e=>e.id===id).starter;
 if(!s.completed){
   active=id; s.started=true; save(id,s); lastTick=Date.now();
 } else {
   active=null; // review does not add to completion time
 }
 await ensurePy(); updateStatus(id);
}
function persistCode(id){let s=state(id),el=document.getElementById(id+"-code");if(el)s.code=el.value;save(id,s)}
function stopEx(id){if(workerJobs.size)resetPythonWorker("Run cancelled with Stop.");if(active===id){tick();persistCode(id);active=null} document.getElementById(id+"-ws").classList.remove("active");updateStatus(id)}
function tick(){let now=Date.now();if(active&&!document.hidden){let s=state(active);s.time+=(now-lastTick)/1000;save(active,s);let el=document.getElementById(active+"-time");if(el)el.textContent=fmt(s.time)}lastTick=now;renderSummary()}
setInterval(tick,1000);document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",()=>{tick();lastTick=Date.now()});
window.addEventListener("beforeunload",()=>{tick();if(active)persistCode(active)});
function updateStatus(id){
 let s=state(id),el=document.getElementById(id+"-status"),btn=document.getElementById(id+"-start");
 if(el)el.innerHTML=(s.completed?"✓ Completed":active===id?"In progress":s.started?"Paused":"Not started")+" · <span class='timer'>"+fmt(s.time)+"</span>";
 if(btn)btn.textContent=s.completed?"Review solution":s.started?"Continue exercise":"Start exercise";
 renderSummary();
}
function requestLiveInput(id,message){
 return new Promise((resolve)=>{
   const area=document.getElementById(id+"-input");
   const field=document.createElement("input");field.type="text";field.autocomplete="off";
   field.setAttribute("aria-label",message||"Python input");
   const label=document.createElement("span");label.textContent=message||"Input:";
   const button=document.createElement("button");button.type="button";button.textContent="Enter";
   area.replaceChildren(label,field,button);area.hidden=false;
   let done=false;
   const finish=(value)=>{if(done)return;done=true;area.hidden=true;area.replaceChildren();resolve(value)};
   button.addEventListener("click",()=>finish(field.value));
   field.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Enter"){e.preventDefault();finish(field.value)}});
   // Yield to the browser to paint the output before focusing the input.
   requestAnimationFrame(()=>field.focus());
 });
}
async function structure(code){return workerTask('structure',code);}
function inputPrompts(code){
 // Extract simple input("prompt") / input('prompt') calls in source order.
 const rx=/input\s*\(\s*(?:(["'])(.*?)\1)?\s*\)/g;
 let a=[],m; while((m=rx.exec(code))!==null)a.push(m[2]||"Enter a value:");
 return a;
}
async function runEx(id){
 let s=state(id),code=document.getElementById(id+"-code").value;
 s.code=code;s.runs++;save(id,s);document.getElementById(id+"-runs").textContent=s.runs;
 const output=document.getElementById(id+"-out");
 output.textContent="";
 try{
 const r=await execute(code,[],true,chunk=>{output.textContent+=chunk;output.scrollTop=output.scrollHeight},id);
 output.textContent=r.ok?r.output:(r.output?r.output+"\n":"")+r.error;
 }catch(err){output.textContent+="\n"+String(err.message||err)}
}
function numbersInLine(line){
 return (line.match(/[-+]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)/g)||[]).map(Number)
}
function rootPairsMatch(out,inputs){
 const n=Number(inputs[0]), lines=out.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
 for(let i=1;i<=n;i++){
   const root=Math.sqrt(i);
   const ok=lines.some(line=>{
     const nums=numbersInLine(line);
     return nums.length>=2 && Math.abs(nums[0]-i)<1e-9 && Math.abs(nums[1]-root)<0.01;
   });
   if(!ok)return false;
 }
 return true;
}
function matches(e,out,expected,inputs=[]){
 let o=out.trim().toLowerCase();
 if(e.match==="structure") return false;
 if(e.match==="rootpairs") return rootPairsMatch(out,inputs);
 if(e.match==="allcontains"){
   let vals=Array.isArray(expected)?expected:[expected];
   return vals.every(v=>o.includes(String(v).toLowerCase()));
 }
 if(e.match==="quadratic"){if(Array.isArray(expected))return expected.every(v=>o.includes(v));return o.includes("no real")||o.includes("no solution")}
 if(e.match==="ends")return o.endsWith(String(expected).toLowerCase());
 return o.includes(String(expected).toLowerCase())
}
function algorithmicCheck(id,st){
 const problems=[];
 if(st.forbidden?.length)problems.push("Use structured flow: no break, continue, or return from inside a loop.");
 if(st.comprehensions)problems.push("Use explicit loops, not comprehensions or generators.");
 const shortcuts=(st.shortcuts||[]).filter(x=>!(id==='ex05'&&['map','filter'].includes(x)));
 if(shortcuts.length)problems.push("Avoid algorithm shortcuts: "+shortcuts.join(', '));
 if(id!=='ex05'&&st.lambda)problems.push("Lambda, map and filter are allowed only when explicitly requested (Exercise 5).");
 const allowed=id==='ex04'?['random']:id==='ex01'?['math']:id==='ex06'?['vectors']:[];
 if(st.imports.some(x=>!allowed.includes(x)))problems.push("Import only the module allowed by this task.");
 if(st.methods.some(x=>['sort','count','index','find','factorial','comb'].includes(x)))problems.push("Implement the requested algorithm explicitly rather than using a method shortcut.");
 return problems;
}
async function week8Match(id,out,inputs){return workerTask('match',out,inputs,false,null,id);}
async function assessExercise(id,updateUI=true){
 let e=EX.find(x=>x.id===id),s=state(id),el=document.getElementById(id+"-code"),code=el?el.value:s.code;
 if(el){s.code=code;save(id,s)}
 let result={id,syntax:false,structure:false,rules:false,functional:false,passed:0,total:e.tests.length,problems:[],missing:[],runtime:null};
 // Empty and print-only placeholders are not meaningful solutions.
 const normalizedCode=(code||"").trim();
 const trivialPrint=/^print\s*\(\s*(?:(?:["'][^"']*["'])|\s*)\s*\)\s*;?\s*$/s.test(normalizedCode);
 if(!normalizedCode || trivialPrint){
   result.syntax=!!normalizedCode;
   result.structure=false; result.rules=false; result.functional=false; result.passed=0;
   result.problems=[!normalizedCode ? "No solution has been entered yet." : "A print-only placeholder does not solve this exercise."];
   if(updateUI){const panel=document.getElementById(id+"-panel");if(panel)panel.innerHTML="<span class='bad'>✗ Not completed.</span><br>"+result.problems.map(esc).join("<br>");}
   return result;
 }

 try{
   await ensurePy(); let st=await structure(code); result.syntax=true;
   result.missing=e.need.filter(n=>!st[n]); result.structure=result.missing.length===0;
   result.problems=algorithmicCheck(id,st); result.rules=result.problems.length===0;
   let rows=[],passed=0;
   for(let t of e.tests){
     let inputs=Array.isArray(t[0])?t[0]:[String(t[0])],r=await execute(code+"\n_main_output = __student_output__()\n"+e.probe+"\nprint(\"__WEEK08_CHECK_OK__\")",inputs,false,null,id);
     if(!r.ok){result.runtime=r.error;break}
     let ok=await week8Match(id,r.output,inputs);if(ok)passed++;
     rows.push({inputs,exp:t[1],got:r.output,ok})
   }
   result.passed=passed;result.rows=rows;
   result.functional=e.match==="structure" ? true : (passed===e.tests.length);
   result.completed=result.syntax&&result.structure&&result.rules&&result.functional&&!result.runtime;
   if(updateUI){
     let panel=document.getElementById(id+"-panel");
     panel.innerHTML="<div class='ok'>✓ Syntax</div>"+
       "<div class='"+(result.structure?"ok":"bad")+"'>"+(result.structure?"✓":"✗")+" Expected structure</div>"+
       "<div class='"+(result.rules?"ok":"bad")+"'>"+(result.rules?"✓":"✗")+" Algorithmic structure</div>"+
       (result.problems.length?result.problems.map(p=>"<div class='bad'>• "+esc(p)+"</div>").join(""):"")+
       (result.runtime?"<div class='bad'>✗ Runtime: "+esc(result.runtime)+"</div>":
        "<div class='"+(result.functional?"ok":"bad")+"'>"+(result.functional?"✓":"✗")+" "+(e.match==="structure"?"Functional behaviour checked by structure":"Functional tests: "+passed+" / "+e.tests.length)+"</div>")+
       rows.map(r=>"<div class='"+(r.ok?"ok":"bad")+"'>"+(r.ok?"✓":"✗")+" input "+esc(r.inputs.join(", "))+" → "+(r.ok?"passed":"output did not meet the task requirements · got: "+esc(r.got||"(no output)"))+"</div>").join("");
     if(result.completed){
       tick();s=state(id);s.completed=true;s.code=code;save(id,s);
       panel.innerHTML+="<div class='hint'><strong>✓ Exercise completed.</strong> Active time: "+fmt(s.time)+". The timer has stopped automatically.</div>";
       if(active===id)active=null;updateStatus(id);
     }
   }
 }catch(err){result.runtime=String(err);if(updateUI)document.getElementById(id+"-panel").innerHTML="<div class='bad'>✗ Checker error</div><div>"+esc(String(err))+"</div>"}
 return result;
}
async function checkEx(id){
 let s=state(id);s.checks++;save(id,s);document.getElementById(id+"-checks").textContent=s.checks;
 await assessExercise(id,true);
}

let practiceEvaluation=null;
function practiceFeedbackPanel(){return `<div class="checkpanel" id="practice-feedback-panel">
 <h3>Optional feedback</h3>
 <p>AI feedback and its estimated percentage are separate from the local checks. Both are learning feedback, not official grades. The AI estimate uses equal weight across all seven exercises; unattempted tasks count as zero.</p>
 <button type="button" id="practice-ai-button" onclick="requestPracticeAI()">Request AI feedback &amp; estimated score</button>
 <div id="practice-ai-result" role="status"></div>
 <hr><button type="button" onclick="showPracticeEmail()">Email my evaluation</button>
 <p class="small">Your dashboard password is required to send this evaluation to your registered email address.</p>
 <div id="practice-email-form" hidden>
   <label for="practice-email-password">Dashboard password</label>
   <input id="practice-email-password" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" maxlength="128">
   <button type="button" id="practice-email-send" onclick="sendPracticeEmail()">Send evaluation</button>
 </div>
 <div id="practice-email-result" role="status"></div>
 </div>`;}
function currentPracticeSnapshot(){
 const ev=practiceEvaluation;
 if(!ev)throw new Error('Run Evaluate my work first.');
 if(getNeptun()!==ev.neptun||EX.some(e=>(document.getElementById(e.id+'-code')?.value ?? state(e.id).code ?? '')!==ev.codes[e.id]))throw new Error('Your code or Neptun code has changed. Run Evaluate my work again before requesting AI feedback or email.');
 return ev;
}
async function practiceRequest(ev,action,password){
 const response=await fetch(PRACTICE_API_BASE+'/practiceFeedback',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({evaluation_id:ev.evaluation_id,feedback_token:ev.feedback_token,neptun:ev.neptun,action,...(action==='email'?{password}: {})})});
 const data=await response.json().catch(()=>({}));
 if(!response.ok)throw new Error(data.error||`Request failed (HTTP ${response.status}).`);
 return data;
}
async function requestPracticeAI(){
 const button=document.getElementById('practice-ai-button'),box=document.getElementById('practice-ai-result');
 let ev;
 try{
   ev=currentPracticeSnapshot();button.disabled=true;
   box.textContent='Preparing AI feedback. This may take about a minute…';
   const data=await practiceRequest(ev,'ai');
   if(practiceEvaluation!==ev)return;
   const stale=EX.some(e=>(document.getElementById(e.id+'-code')?.value ?? state(e.id).code ?? '')!==ev.codes[e.id]);
   box.innerHTML=`<h4>Estimated AI score: ${Number(data.ai.estimated_percent)}%</h4><p class="small">Indicative estimate, not an official grade. Based on the saved evaluation snapshot.${stale?' Your code has since changed; evaluate again for updated feedback.':''}</p>`+data.ai.exercises.map(e=>`<div class="hint"><strong>${esc(e.title)}: ${Number(e.percent)}%</strong><p>${esc(e.feedback).replace(/\n/g,'<br>')}</p></div>`).join('');
 }catch(error){if(!ev||practiceEvaluation===ev)box.textContent=error.message||'AI feedback is unavailable. The local evaluation remains available.';}
 finally{button.disabled=false;}
}
function showPracticeEmail(){
 const box=document.getElementById('practice-email-result');
 try{currentPracticeSnapshot();document.getElementById('practice-email-form').hidden=false;document.getElementById('practice-email-password').focus();box.textContent='The saved local evaluation and any completed AI feedback will be sent. No new AI evaluation is started.';}
 catch(error){box.textContent=error.message;}
}
async function sendPracticeEmail(){
 const button=document.getElementById('practice-email-send'),box=document.getElementById('practice-email-result'),field=document.getElementById('practice-email-password');
 let ev;
 try{ev=currentPracticeSnapshot();if(!field.value)throw new Error('Enter your dashboard password.');button.disabled=true;box.textContent='Verifying your password and sending the evaluation…';
   const password=field.value;field.value='';
   const data=await practiceRequest(ev,'email',password);
   if(practiceEvaluation!==ev)return;
   box.textContent=data.cached?'This evaluation has already been emailed.':'The email service confirmed sending the evaluation to your registered address.';
   document.getElementById('practice-email-form').hidden=true;
 }catch(error){if(!ev||practiceEvaluation===ev)box.textContent=error.message||'Email could not be confirmed.';}
 finally{field.value='';button.disabled=false;}
}

async function evaluateWork(){
 practiceEvaluation=null;
 tick();
 const snapshotCodes=Object.fromEntries(EX.map(e=>[e.id,document.getElementById(e.id+"-code")?.value ?? state(e.id).code ?? ""]));

 const btn=document.getElementById("evaluate-work"),box=document.getElementById("evaluation-result");
 btn.disabled=true;box.innerHTML="<p>Evaluating current solutions…</p>";
 const results=[];
 for(const e of EX){
   const s=state(e.id);
   if(!s.started && !s.code.trim()){results.push({id:e.id,attempted:false,completed:false});continue}
   const r=await assessExercise(e.id,false);r.attempted=true;results.push(r);
 }
 const attempted=results.filter(r=>r.attempted), completed=results.filter(r=>r.completed);
 const functional=attempted.filter(r=>r.functional).length, rules=attempted.filter(r=>r.rules&&r.structure).length;
 let points=0;
 for(const r of results){
   if(!r.attempted)continue;
   points += (r.functional?0.6:0)+(r.structure?0.2:0)+(r.rules?0.2:0);
 }
 const score=Math.round(100*points/EX.length);
 const suggestions=[];
 if(attempted.length<EX.length)suggestions.push("Continue with the exercises that have not been attempted yet.");
 if(functional<attempted.length)suggestions.push("Review the task requirements for exercises whose functional tests do not pass.");
 if(rules<attempted.length)suggestions.push("Review loop choice and structured control flow. Use return for function results, but not to escape loops. Lambda/map/filter belong only to explicitly requested tasks.");
 if(results.some(r=>r.problems?.some(p=>p.includes("condition-controlled while"))))suggestions.push("For search-style tasks, use a while condition that stops the search as soon as the result is known.");
 if(!suggestions.length)suggestions.push("Your current solutions satisfy the deterministic checks. Try explaining the loop condition and result of each algorithm.");
 const no=(Number(localStorage.getItem("pycourse_week08_evaluation_no")||"0")+1);
 localStorage.setItem("pycourse_week08_evaluation_no",String(no));

 if(EX.some(e=>(document.getElementById(e.id+"-code")?.value ?? state(e.id).code ?? "")!==snapshotCodes[e.id])){box.textContent="Your code changed during evaluation. Run Evaluate my work again.";btn.disabled=false;return;}
 const payload={
   schema_version:"1.0",
   week:"08",
   neptun:getNeptun(),
   evaluation_no:no,
   evaluated_at:new Date().toISOString(),
   indicative_score:score,
   summary:{attempted:attempted.length,completed:completed.length,functional_passed:functional,rules_passed:rules,total:EX.length},
   exercises:EX.map(e=>{
     const s=state(e.id),r=results.find(x=>x.id===e.id)||{};
     return {
       exercise_id:e.id,
       source_code:snapshotCodes[e.id],
       started:!!s.started,
       active_time_seconds:Math.round(s.time||0),
       run_count:s.runs||0,
       check_count:s.checks||0,
       hint_count:s.hints||0,
       attempted:!!r.attempted,
       completed:!!r.completed,
       syntax:!!r.syntax,
       structure:!!r.structure,
       rules:!!r.rules,
       functional:!!r.functional,
       rule_violations:r.problems||[]
     };
   })
 };

 let uploadMessage="<span class='small'>Saving learning analytics to Azure…</span>";
 box.innerHTML=`<div class="hint"><strong>Indicative evaluation: ${score}%</strong><br>
 ${completed.length} / ${EX.length} exercises currently completed successfully.<br>
 Functional correctness: ${functional} / ${attempted.length||0} attempted.<br>
 Programming and algorithmic rules: ${rules} / ${attempted.length||0} attempted.<br>
 <strong>This evaluation is for feedback only and does not count toward your course grade.</strong>
 <br><br><strong>Suggestions</strong><ul>${suggestions.map(x=>"<li>"+esc(x)+"</li>").join("")}</ul>
 <span class="small">Evaluation #${no}. You can improve your solutions and evaluate again.</span><br>
 <span id="practice-upload-status">${uploadMessage}</span></div>`;
 renderSummary();document.getElementById("summary").style.display="block";

 try{
   if(!validNeptun(payload.neptun)) throw new Error("A valid Neptun code is required.");
   const resp=await fetch(PRACTICE_API_BASE+"/submitPractice",{
     method:"POST",
     headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},
     body:JSON.stringify(payload)
   });
   const data=await resp.json().catch(()=>({}));
   if(!resp.ok) throw new Error(data.error||("HTTP "+resp.status));
   document.getElementById("practice-upload-status").innerHTML="✓ Learning analytics saved successfully.";
   if(data.evaluation_id && data.feedback_token){
     practiceEvaluation={evaluation_id:data.evaluation_id,feedback_token:data.feedback_token,neptun:payload.neptun,codes:snapshotCodes};
     document.getElementById('evaluation-result').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',practiceFeedbackPanel());
   }
 }catch(err){
   document.getElementById("practice-upload-status").innerHTML="⚠ Evaluation completed locally, but the analytics upload failed: "+esc(String(err.message||err));
 }
 btn.disabled=false;
}
function hintEx(id){let s=state(id);s.hints++;save(id,s);document.getElementById(id+"-hints").textContent=s.hints;document.getElementById(id+"-panel").innerHTML+="<div class='hint'>"+esc(EX.find(e=>e.id===id).hint)+"</div>"}
render();
document.addEventListener("input",e=>{if(e.target.matches("textarea.code")){const id=e.target.id.replace(/-code$/,"");let s=state(id);s.code=e.target.value;s.completed=false;save(id,s);updateStatus(id)}});
document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.target.matches("textarea.code")&&e.key==="Tab"){e.preventDefault();const el=e.target,a=el.selectionStart,b=el.selectionEnd;el.setRangeText("    ",a,b,"end");el.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true}))}});
document.getElementById("save-neptun")?.addEventListener("click",saveNeptun);
document.getElementById("neptun-code")?.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Enter")saveNeptun()});
document.getElementById("neptun-code")?.addEventListener("input",e=>{e.target.value=e.target.value.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g,"").slice(0,6)});
setNeptunUI();

</script>
